data.narrative:
Quantum-Systems is a Series C-stage defense and security company currently valued at $8.0B post-money after raising $1.2B cumulatively. The valuation is assessed against a universe of 11 same-sector and adjacent-stage peers, comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Helsing, Saronic, Anduril Industries, and Shield AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using a typical Series C-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.7x applied to the current $8.0B valuation, implies $13.6B. Peer-median analysis across the 11-company comp set yielded a median valuation of $1.4B, with a range spanning $300M to $18.0B; this wide dispersion reflects material stage and performance heterogeneity within the defense-tech sector.

The two methods produce divergent signals. Stage-progression suggests upside momentum to $13.6B, while peer-median suggests the current valuation already reflects a premium positioning. Triangulating across both methods yields a range of $1.2B (low) to $15.6B (high), with a median of $7.5B. The $8.0B current valuation sits within this range near the median, suggesting it is reasonable relative to observable stage and peer benchmarks. Key uncertainties include execution risk on product roadmap and the high concentration of late-stage ($18.0B+ valuations in the comp set, which may not represent durable value without clear path to profitability or clear exit.
